description: Five Day Notification for tree works: trees with dead/broken branches that surround the perimeter of the top field. T243 - Fraxinus - Large specimen, multiple dead in crown. T353 - Prunus - multiple dead in crown. Tree survey has noted its decline. Due to its placement, get it to a safe condition and look to replace later. T344 - Tilia - Main tree is dead, basal growth only. Removal of all dead material. T377 - Fraxinus - Multiple dead in crown.T359 - Quercus - Multiple dead in crown.T297 - Betula - Whole tree is dead - removal. 12cm diameter at 1.5 DBH.T285 - Thuja - Multiple dead in crown.Next to T283 - Dead tree next to Thuja. Looks to have been dead for some time and may fall. Removal requested. 20cm Diameter at 1.5 DBH.Two Sambucus between 291 and 288. Contain a number of dead that is to be removed. Sycamore seedling is in the hedge on the road between T235 & T234. It is growing at an awkward angle into the railing and going to become problematic as it gets bigger. To be brought down to an appropriate height so that it can be managed within the hedge line on annual basis when cut the hedges.
